newsitem.title: ESTONIA: VOLUME FALLS AWAY, HOIU AND HANSA MOST ACTIVE.
newsitem.headline: VOLUME FALLS AWAY, HOIU AND HANSA MOST ACTIVE.

text.p: Volumes fell away on Tuesday on
the Estonian bourse, with some interest in Hansapank and
Hoiupank sustaining the market.
But dealers said the low liquidity was exaggerating price
movements. Total trade on the main list was 26.2 million kroons
with the Talse 0.78 percent higher at 253.36.
"Some of the price changes we saw today were too great for
the volume," one trader said.
"Low liquidity on the bourse is affecting the prices more
than news," he added.
Hoiupank was most traded with 8.1 million kroons moved for a
small price gain of 0.42 kroons to reach 132.27 kroons.
"Its price is traded on a bit of a premium compared to the
rest of the market, but its results are solid and its earnings
are getting better," one dealer said.
Hansapank rose 2.05 kroons to 132.90 kroons on trade worth
6.3 million kroons.
Its shares have also been boosted by news that it would
consider offers from foreign banks for a partnership although it
was not actively seeking an investor.
The free market turned over 2.5 million kroons with Tallinna
Kaubamaja the most active stock with a trade of 0.8
million kroons.
Tallinna Kaubamaja department store picked up 0.40 kroons to
close on 41.90 kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom, +372 620 9202/1
